dct_description_sm: Concerns were raised by Inuvialuit hunters harvesting caribou in response to the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear accident. This project aims to determine the radioactive contaminant levels in caribou. Caribou are an important country foods in the Canadian Arctic. The analysis will provide information about whether or not contaminants levels in these resources have changed since the accident relatively to previous levels. It was important to ensure the food safety as well as address the concerns raised by community members.
dct_title_s: Monitoring Radioactivity in Caribou in response to the Fukushima accident (post and pre)
